LanguageData.MF_GenericSpellStatusCue.label: affected by magic
LanguageData.MF_GenericSpellStatusCue.description: This pawn is affected by a spell.
LanguageData.MF_Hasted.label: hasted
LanguageData.MF_Hasted.description: This pawn's movement speed is increased by 35%.
LanguageData.MF_BlessedVigor.label: blessed with vigor
LanguageData.MF_BlessedVigor.description: This pawn's movement speed is increased by 12%, and general labor speed is increased by 10%.
LanguageData.MF_Mighty.label: mighty
LanguageData.MF_Mighty.description: This pawn's melee damage is increased by 35%, and carrying capacity is increased by 25 kg.
LanguageData.MF_Weakened.label: weakened
LanguageData.MF_Weakened.description: This pawn's melee damage is reduced by 25%, and carrying capacity is reduced by 15 kg.
LanguageData.MF_ForceFielded.label: force fielded
LanguageData.MF_ForceFielded.description: This pawn is protected by a maintained force field that reduces incoming damage by 50% while the caster keeps focus.
LanguageData.MF_ManaShielded.label: mana shielded
LanguageData.MF_ManaShielded.description: This pawn is protected by a shield that spends the caster's mana to fully absorb incoming damage, and costs upkeep while maintained.
LanguageData.MF_Regenerating.label: regenerating
LanguageData.MF_Regenerating.description: This pawn's wounds are being gradually restored by vital magic.
LanguageData.MF_CleansedBlood.label: cleansed blood
LanguageData.MF_CleansedBlood.description: This pawn is under a maintained vital charm that periodically treats disease and infection.
LanguageData.MF_SharedEssence.label: shared essence
LanguageData.MF_SharedEssence.description: This pawn's life force has been temporarily entwined with another through resurrection magic, leaving consciousness dimmed while the bond settles.
LanguageData.MF_TemporalReconstruction.label: temporal reconstruction
LanguageData.MF_TemporalReconstruction.description: This pawn has been pulled backward through the moment of death. Wounds are unwinding while memory and practiced skill shear away into lost time.
LanguageData.MF_Frozen.label: frozen
LanguageData.MF_Frozen.description: This pawn's movement speed is reduced by 45%.
LanguageData.MF_Waterbound.label: waterbound
LanguageData.MF_Waterbound.description: This pawn's movement speed is reduced by 65% by animated water.
LanguageData.MF_HeldUnder.label: held under
LanguageData.MF_HeldUnder.description: This pawn is being forced beneath animated water and is struggling to stay conscious.
LanguageData.MF_Desiccated.label: desiccated
LanguageData.MF_Desiccated.description: This pawn's tissues have been magically dried, making their limbs stiff and painful to use.
LanguageData.MF_PlagueLesion.label: plague lesion
LanguageData.MF_PlagueLesion.description: A raw lesion raised by forbidden plague magic.
LanguageData.MF_PlagueBlister.label: plague blister
LanguageData.MF_PlagueBlister.description: A swollen blister raised by forbidden plague magic.
LanguageData.MF_ForbiddenPlague.label: forbidden plague
LanguageData.MF_ForbiddenPlague.description: A magical contagion that spreads between people and periodically raises painful lesions and blisters unless treated.
LanguageData.MFV_UndeadNature.label: undead nature
LanguageData.MFV_UndeadNature.description: This pawn carries the shared metaphysical state of undeath.
LanguageData.MFV_SkeletalBody.label: skeletal body
LanguageData.MFV_SkeletalBody.description: This pawn has a skeletal undead body.
LanguageData.MFV_SkeletalLimitations.label: skeletal limitations
LanguageData.MFV_SkeletalLimitations.description: This skeletal body has limited awareness and dexterity.
